name: Taliaferro Imports
old_description: We are a family owned and operated business here in the same building since 1990.
about:
Taliaferro Imports, Inc., doing business as GenuineSaab.com, is a family-owned and operated company based in Springfield, Missouri. Established in 1990, the business has remained in the same building since its founding. The source does not identify the founders by name.

The company operates a CNC machine shop with four CNC machines, producing its own line of Saab performance parts that are used globally on high-performance Saab vehicles. In addition to manufacturing, Taliaferro Imports offers in-house chassis dynamometer services for customer rental, product development, and validation, supported by advanced data acquisition capabilities. The firm also stocks and distributes factory Saab parts, aftermarket Swedish performance components, and provides ECU calibration services. Orders are shipped worldwide via UPS.

Taliaferro Imports serves Saab owners, enthusiasts, and repair shops worldwide. Its customer base includes individuals seeking genuine Saab parts and performance upgrades, as well as professional tuners utilizing the company’s dyno and development services. The company is an authorized BSR performance dealer, and its manufactured parts are noted as being used on some of the world’s fastest Saabs.

The company emphasizes its identity as “Genuine Saab People” who use the parts they sell, highlighting knowledgeable, prompt, and enthusiastic service. Its in-house manufacturing and dyno capabilities allow for product validation and custom parts development, differentiating it from pure resellers.

about:
Tall T, doing business as TallT, is an apparel brand headquartered in Denver, Colorado. The company does not publicly disclose its founding year, ownership structure, or the names of its founders.

TallT designs and sells a range of snow sports and streetwear products, including the TallT x MaxReade Snowpants V3, Classic Logo hoodies, graphic t-shirts such as the Ichwawa and Blank Tee, headwear like the Boonie Hat and Snapback, face masks, and accessory packs. The brand collaborates with professional athletes such as freeskier Henrik Harlaut and snowboarder Max Reade to create signature outerwear collections. Products are offered through a direct-to-consumer e-commerce site and a wholesale channel for retail partners. The company also operates a mobile shopping application.

The brand serves the snow sports, outdoor recreation, and streetwear markets. Its customer base includes individual consumers purchasing through the online store and wholesale buyers such as specialty retailers. Product lines feature extended sizing options, including tall fits labeled XL TALL, 3XL TALL, and 5XL TALL.

TallT states that its mission is to provide confidence on the mountain, emphasizing that its pants are designed to deliver a feeling of performance and style rather than simply a product.

name: Tampa Clothing Company INC.
old_description: Designs in 7 days • Production 2–3 weeks after approval • No minimums • Made in USA
about:
Tampa Clothing Company operates from Hudson, Florida, as a family-owned custom apparel manufacturer. The company produces all-over dye-sublimated garments entirely in the United States and does not outsource any production steps.

The shop focuses on full-color dye sublimation across a catalog of shirts, polos, hoodies, tanks, and fleece items in sizes from youth small to 8X. Design turnaround is quoted at seven days, with production shipping two to three weeks after artwork approval. No minimum order quantities are required, and the company handles design, manufacturing, and fulfillment in-house.

Customers span business and brand launches, event and promotional needs, corporate uniform programs, sports teams requiring jerseys with names and numbers, trades and services such as pressure washing and property maintenance, and schools or groups ordering personalized class and club apparel.

The company emphasizes its family-owned structure, domestic manufacturing, and a no-minimums policy as core differentiators, positioning itself as a partner that takes a project from first sketch to final stitch without leaving U.S. soil.

name: Taylor Sales and Service
old_description: Serving Alabama the best service and the best equipment - for 40 years!
about:
Taylor Sales and Service operates from Birmingham, Alabama, as a locally owned and operated distributor of foodservice equipment and products. The company has served the state for over three decades, with leadership including President Jimmy Palmer and Sales Manager James Palmer.

The firm sells, installs, and services commercial foodservice equipment — primarily Taylor-brand frozen dessert, beverage, and grill systems. Its capabilities include preventive maintenance, emergency repair, new-equipment installation, parts supply, and a state-of-the-art test kitchen where customers can trial the latest Taylor models. A team of Taylor-certified technicians, a dedicated parts manager, and an install crew support operations across Alabama.

Customers range from independent restaurants and frozen-yogurt shops to national quick-service chains such as McDonald’s and Chick-fil-A, as well as convenience stores and institutional accounts like the University of Alabama at Birmingham. Technicians are frequently dispatched to service ice cream machines, frozen cocktail dispensers, custard freezers, and grills at these locations.

The company emphasizes a value system built on integrity, persistence, knowledge, teamwork, passion, and work-life balance. It highlights “master level know-how” from its certified technicians and notes that one of its technicians, Allen Hinkle, earned the Red Cape Technician of the Year award in 2022.

name: Team 1 Plastics
old_description: As a plastic injection molding company for the transportation industry, Team 1 Plastics specializes in precision and clear plastic components which are used in many different systems.
about:
Team 1 Plastics operates from Albion, Michigan, a central Midwestern location that the company says allows easy access for customer molding trials and technical meetings. The founding year and ownership structure are not disclosed in public materials, and no founders are named.

The company specializes in precision and transparent plastic injection molding for the transportation sector. Its facility runs 24/7 with a highly automated line: every press is equipped with robots to reduce handling damage and labor costs. Team 1 Plastics emphasizes low mold cavitation — very few tools exceed eight cavities — which it says delivers higher precision and repeatable quality matched to each customer’s annual volume. Beyond molding, it provides value‑added assembly, part consolidation, supply‑chain services (returnable packaging, custom labeling, bar‑code tracking, day/night shipments via its own fleet or customer milk runs), and manages new tool design or transfer tooling bring‑up.

Customers include automotive OEMs and Tier suppliers, as well as manufacturers of oil, fuel (gasoline and diesel), and air filtration systems. The company’s components appear in automobile systems and filtration products across these segments.

Team 1 Plastics states its differentiation rests on a disciplined quality system certified to IATF 16949:2016 and ISO 9001:2015, a zero‑defect mentality supported by cross‑functional corrective‑action meetings, and an Activity‑Based Costing model updated through self‑evaluation and customer feedback.

name: Team Technologies
old_description: Providing new product design, development and supplemental engineering services.
about:
Team Technologies is based in Albuquerque, New Mexico, operating from a 36,000-square-foot facility that houses engineering, machining, and electronics assembly under one roof. The founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed.

The company provides new product design, development, and supplemental engineering services alongside manufacturing capabilities. Its machine shop runs CNC vertical milling (3-, 4-, and 5-axis), CNC tool room lathes with live tooling, wire and sinker EDM (wire down to 0.001 inch), surface grinding, and precision welding (TIG, MIG, and Class 4 laser). The electronics side offers full turnkey PCB and box-build assembly, SMT and through-hole placement with dual automated pick-and-place lines handling 0201 components and BGAs, 2D X-ray and AOI inspection, in-circuit test, custom cable assembly, and sub-assembly fabrication. Metrology includes two DCC CMMs (750 × 750 × 550 mm), a DCC optical video gauge, and surface plates.

Team Technologies serves government and commercial clients, with noted work in aerospace components, biomedical devices, RF products, and video/data systems. The company also supports energetic materials such as firesets and CDUs, and provides obsolescence lifecycle management.

The company emphasizes on-time, on-budget performance and an integrated "simulation to prototype to production" model that combines design, machining, electronics, and inspection in a single facility.

name: Tech Partners Hawaii
old_description: Over 20 years and hundreds of clients across the Hawaiian Islands. We keep your business running so you don't have to think about IT.
about:
Tech Partners Hawaii has provided IT support from its Wailuku, Maui base for over two decades. The locally owned company was founded to serve businesses across the Hawaiian Islands and now works with hundreds of clients throughout the chain.

The firm delivers a full stack of managed technology services: managed IT, IT consulting, VoIP, Microsoft 365 administration, cloud solutions, cybersecurity, backup and disaster recovery, and network management. Its team holds multiple certifications and operates a 24/7 help desk to keep client systems running continuously.

Customers span Hawaii's key sectors, including hospitality and tourism, non-profits, development and construction, manufacturing, medical practices, and agriculture. The company tailors its support to the operational rhythms of each industry, from resort networks to clinic compliance requirements.

Tech Partners Hawaii differentiates itself through six stated pillars: local ownership with island-specific knowledge, certified expertise, responsive 24/7 support, a multilayered security framework, seamless migration from in-house or other providers, and a customer-service culture aligned with Hawaii's community values.

name: Technical Services Inc
old_description: Mission‑critical electronics built to Class 3 with full traceability.
about:
Technical Services Inc (TSI) operates from a 100,000-square-foot facility in Oak Harbor, Washington. The company is employee-owned, meaning the workforce holds a direct stake in the business.

TSI provides electronics manufacturing services including surface-mount and through-hole PCB assembly, box builds, X-ray inspection, and turnkey procurement. The plant runs six SMT lines capable of high-mix to high-volume production, and offers conformal coating in acrylic and polyurethane, functional/ICT/RF testing with partner-developed fixtures, programming, labeling, and complete box-build integration. The company supports fast ramp from new product introduction to production with flexible volumes and offers DFM/DFX support along with turnkey, consignment, or hybrid material strategies.

The company serves aerospace and military, commercial, medical, and industrial markets. For aerospace and military customers it builds mission-critical electronics to IPC Class 3 with full component traceability. Medical clients receive quality-sensitive builds with documented controls and ISO 13485 certification. Industrial customers get rugged control and power electronics designed for uptime, while commercial programs benefit from rapid NPI-to-production scaling and cost-down supply chain options.

TSI emphasizes its employee-ownership model as a differentiator, stating that every build is personal because the team owns the outcome. It cites a 99.96% on-time delivery rate over a rolling 12-month period, an RMA rate below 0.6%, and a certified quality system encompassing ISO 9001, AS9100D, and ISO 13485. The company also highlights Class 3 workmanship with 100% automated optical inspection on both sides of assemblies and full supply chain management from PCBAs to complete box builds.
